# volaw-daw

> volaw-daw is a digital audio workstation for composing music for the Vows of Love and War game audio engine. It is a Rust workspace with a `no_std` audio
> engine crate, a `no_std` DAW logic crate with Keleusma scripting, and an SDL3 composer binary.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is an index for language models and agents
that read the repository from outside, such as a model asked to write code against it.
Links are absolute, so the file works when fetched on its own. They name `HEAD`,
which GitHub resolves to the default branch, whatever it is called.

## Start Here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgeos/volaw-daw/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): onboarding for any AI assistant.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/sgeos/volaw-daw/blob/HEAD/CLAUDE.md): authoritative project context, conventions and per-session protocol.
- [README](https://github.com/sgeos/volaw-daw/blob/HEAD/README.md): project overview and quick start.
